references.name: WHO Human — Fertile (normospermic)
references.description: Synthetic cell-level CSV approximating a WHO 5th-edition normospermic profile. Measured on the shipped data: PR≈53%, NP≈22%, IM≈25%, hyperactivated≈6.5%, VCL≈66±56 µm/s (a heterogeneous motile+immotile mixture, not a tight Gaussian). Built from published reference ranges (WHO 2010, Mortimer 1990, Holt 1985); not real-patient data.

references.name: WHO Human — Subfertile (asthenozoospermia)
references.description: Synthetic cell-level CSV approximating a sub-WHO (asthenozoospermia) profile. Measured on the shipped data: PR≈22%, NP≈28%, IM≈49%, hyperactivated≈1.6%, VCL≈23±31 µm/s. Useful as a contrastive reference for the Prediction page; not real-patient data.
